_provenance: Hand-checked paediatric eGFR cases (issue #66, 2026-11-22). Not generated by the Python package. CKiD U25: Pierce CB et al., Kidney Int 2021;99:948 (PMID 33301749), eGFR = k x height[m] / Scr[mg/dl]; bedside Schwartz: Schwartz GJ et al., JASN 2009;20:629 (PMID 19158356), 0.413 x height[cm] / Scr; EKFC: Pottel H et al., Ann Intern Med 2021;174:183 (doi:10.7326/M20-4366), Q polynomial for ages up to 25 in umol/l divided by 88.4. Each value was computed by hand (powers via ln/exp to six digits) and checked against a direct evaluation; see docs/method-algorithms/egfr.md, 'Children and adolescents'.
_derivation_note: Added 2026-11-23 (owner decision on OD-70): CKiD U25 applies from age 1; under 2 years a creatinine value needs a height within 30 days (same day, or interpolated between two heights both at most 30 days away), from 2 years 90 days; EKFC stays from age 2, so age 1 without such a height gives no value; under 1 no value. The formula cases above already covered age 1; these row-level cases pin the derivation (rowEgfrFormula, appendComputedEgfr) at the new age floor. eGFR rounded to one decimal as stored. k(1, m) = 39.0 x 1.008^-11 = 35.727181; k(1, w) = 36.1 x 1.008^-11 = 33.070545; k(2, m) = 39.0 x 1.008^-10 = 36.012999.
